edits.new_text: """One controlled feudal construction action and its durable confirmation.

# The paused semantic frame is itself a same-revision gold read.
    # No positive-cost building can pass the exact native reserve
    # when its public gold is already at or below that reserve.
    from .bridge.domain_construction_private_transport_v1 import RESERVE_RAW
    public_gold = snapshot.get("played_character_gold")
    if (snapshot.get("paused") is True and snapshot.get("map_ready") is True
            and planned.get("revision") == snapshot.get("revision")
            and isinstance(public_gold, Mapping)
            and public_gold.get("scale") == 100_000
            and type(public_gold.get("raw")) is int
            and public_gold["raw"] <= RESERVE_RAW):
        if prewar:
            return prewar_unchanged("public_gold_below_native_reserve")
        return {**planned, "plan": {**plan, "construction_spend_deferred": {
            "status": "public_gold_below_native_reserve",
            "snapshot_id": snapshot.get("snapshot_id"),
            "revision": snapshot.get("revision"),
            "current_treasury_raw": public_gold["raw"],
            "native_reserve_raw": RESERVE_RAW}}}

# A same-frame treasury below the native reserve cannot admit
    # any positive-cost building. Avoid the optional private scan
    # while retaining the already selected ordinary action.
    budget = observed.get("current_cash_scenarios") if isinstance(observed, Mapping) else None
    frame = budget.get("source_frame") if isinstance(budget, Mapping) else None
    resources = budget.get("source_cash_resources") if isinstance(budget, Mapping) else None
    treasury = resources.get("current_treasury") if isinstance(resources, Mapping) else None
    readiness = resources.get("readiness") if isinstance(resources, Mapping) else None
    reserve = budget.get("reserve_gold_raw") if isinstance(budget, Mapping) else None
    commitment = budget.get("existing_commitment_gold_raw") if isinstance(budget, Mapping) else None
    if (isinstance(budget, Mapping) and budget.get("status") == "available"
            and isinstance(frame, Mapping) and isinstance(resources, Mapping)
            and resources.get("status") == "available"
            and isinstance(readiness, Mapping) and readiness.get("same_frame_ready") is True
            and isinstance(treasury, Mapping) and treasury.get("scale") == 100_000
            and budget.get("gold_scale") == 100_000
            and type(treasury.get("raw")) is int
            and type(reserve) is int and reserve >= 0
            and type(commitment) is int and commitment >= 0
            and frame.get("queried_revision") == planned.get("revision")
            and frame.get("snapshot_revision") == snapshot.get("native_revision")
            and frame.get("date_raw") == snapshot.get("date_raw")
            and frame.get("played_character_id") == (
                snapshot.get("played_character", {}).get("character_id")
                if isinstance(snapshot.get("played_character"), Mapping) else None)
            and treasury["raw"] < reserve + commitment):
        return {**planned, "plan": {**plan, "construction_spend_deferred": {
            "status": "below_native_reserve",
            "current_treasury_raw": treasury["raw"],
            "required_reserve_and_commitment_raw": reserve + commitment,
            "same_frame_cash_source": observed.get("source")}}}
    query = query_construction_private(driver, expected_revision=int(planned["revision"]))
